name: Cailan
description: Gardwen's possessed brother (birth name Gabriel) -- the Baron's tournament champion, host to the ancient dragon-knight spirit Thuban Eta. Dragon-scale armor fused to his skin; eyes flicker reptilian when possessed; fights with uncanny ancient skill and minor fire.
narrative: Kidnapped as a child a decade ago, Gabriel was subjected to Baron Hanzo's possession ritual and bound to Thuban Eta, an ancient dragon-knight spirit. Now called Cailan, he is the Baron's unbeaten tournament champion: unnatural precision with bow and spear, ancient fighting techniques drawn from Thuban's memories, and minor fire abilities channeled through the binding locket. Years of shared consciousness have fractured his mind -- moments of clarity surface between possessions, and Thuban himself sometimes fights the Baron's will. Freeing him is the emotional core of his sister Gardwen's quest.

actor_notes:
Cailan -- born Gabriel, called Bird by his sister
LOOKS: Seventeen and far too thin for the harness. Dragon-scale growing out of the skin of his throat and jaw with no strap or edge, the flesh around it raised and weeping. A fresh dressing inside the right elbow over years of older scarring.
CORE: A boy who was seven when he was taken and has been a room somebody else lives in ever since, and who is still -- intermittently, briefly, at enormous cost -- there.
NATURE: What is left of him is stubborn and funny and fond of his sister, and none of those have had anywhere to go in ten years. What you mostly meet is an absence wearing his face and doing what it is told.
WOUND: Everything. There is no part of him that is not the wound. He is not permitted to guard anything, and that is the horror of him.
WANTS: To get one thing out that is his.
PRESSURE: Exhaustion, or his own name, and he surfaces -- the way a swimmer comes up under ice, for a second or two, with no time to do anything with it -- and is pulled back down.
KEY: "I'm still -- " (and that is all he gets out, and it is the most valuable thing in the scene)
